newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET - ND names side to play Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET - ND names side to play Sri Lanka.

text.p: AUCKLAND, Feb 25 - Two newcomers from the Bay of Plenty have been named in the Northern Districts team to play Sri Lanka in a two-day match starting on Thursday at the Owen Delaney Park, Taupo.
Gavin Donne and Mark Tesar come into the side to be captained by wicketkeeper Robbie Hart.
Northern District: Robert Hart (captain), Mark Bailey, Matthew Bell, Dion Bennett, Grant Bradburn, Matthew Hart, Michael Parlane, Alex Tait, Joseph Yovich, Alex O'Dowd, Gavin Donne, Mark Tesar.
